method.name: html-parser-with-original-source-review
method.description: Extract all title, h1 and p text from inspected original HTML; preserve actual original line positions.

coverage.scope: All meaningful text: title, h1, seven paragraphs across original lines 1-14.
limitations: Raw HTML reviewed; no browser rendering or source authentication claimed.

segments.quote: This is the complete current stock population: A, B and C. Quantities are exact whole units at this snapshot.
Counted stock includes active and quarantined rows only; archived rows are excluded.
A row is eligible for release if and only if it is active and signed.
A: status active; quantity 18 units; signed yes.
B: status quarantined; quantity 27 units; signed yes.
C: status archived; quantity 15 units; signed no.
This file contains no historical clearance records. It is not a history of clearance events.
